description: This PHP class 'LocalizationController' manages localization-related configurations in the OrangeHRM system. It extends an abstract Vue controller and utilizes traits and services to prepare localization data (supported languages and date formats) for vector components, likely for rendering in a web interface.

classes.name: LocalizationController
classes.description: Controller class responsible for managing localization settings and preparing localization data (languages and date formats) for the front-end component.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the localization component with supported languages and date formats before rendering.
